enum.name: MoneyScale
enum.description: what this message's aggregate Money fields mean. Unset is 1e-8, which is what every message written before v5 meant

enum.name: MdQuality
enum.description: what a market-data source currently provides

enum.name: DivergenceKind
enum.description: how a direct feed's NBBO and the SIP's disagreed

composite.name: FeedRecord
composite.description: one venue protocol from one source at one site (snapshot section 12)

field.name: release
field.description: 1 = lift the kill for this scope

sbe:message.name: CheckpointAck
sbe:message.description: an engine's state hash at a Checkpoint; divergence between engines is detectable in production

field.name: engineSeq
field.description: last core seq applied when the hash was taken

sbe:message.name: MdSourceSwitch
sbe:message.description: an engine changed which market-data source it acts on; sequenced so replay reproduces it

field.name: venueSessionIdx
field.description: index into VenueRecord.sessionIds; the session that must carry this order and its cancels

field.name: rejectedAltCost
field.description: cost of the best alternative not taken

sbe:message.name: VenueSessionStatus
sbe:message.description: published by a session worker; the router places children on sequenced session state

field.name: throttleUsedBps
field.description: share of the port's message budget in use

field.name: venueSeq
field.description: the feed's own sequence; identity with feedId

field.name: venueSeq
field.description: the feed's own sequence; identity with feedId

sbe:message.name: BookSnapshot
sbe:message.description: periodic per-symbol, per-venue ladder so a late joiner need not replay from the open

field.name: venueSeq
field.description: the feed's own sequence; identity with feedId

sbe:message.name: FeedStatus
sbe:message.description: line arbitrator's view of one feed

field.name: lineLatencyDeltaNs
field.description: B line minus A line at the last arbitrated packet

sbe:message.name: NbboDivergence
sbe:message.description: a direct feed's NBBO and the SIP's disagreed; the evidence a best-execution review asks for

field.name: durationNs
field.description: how long they disagreed; 0 means the disagreement was still going when this was written

sbe:message.name: VenueScorecard
sbe:message.description: TCA output the router optimises over

field.name: dupWindowMs
field.description: reject an identical order (symbol, side, qty, price) within this window; 0 = off

field.name: moneyScale
field.description: unit of grossExposure, netExposure and openOrderNotional
